title: Contradiction on renown, authentication
content:
## Involved claims

- The Academy's Renown SDK page documents a RenownUserProvider and useUser that @renown/sdk does not export — `190cf9aa-4667-40b9-b6b1-4a8bf17e79e3`
- The Renown SDK is built through a RenownBuilder whose every dependency is injectable, and its React components live in reactor-browser rather than in the SDK — `49c7215e-c5f3-40ca-b98d-22a18128e6cb`

## Why this exists

A `CONTRADICTS` relationship was recorded between these two notes at 2026-09-03T07:49:28.335Z. The vault treats a recorded contradiction as an open question, not a fact to leave implicit: until someone resolves or dissolves this tension, both claims stand and readers should see that they disagree.

## How to close it

- **Resolve** when one claim is correct: say which, and consider `SUPERSEDES` on the winner.
- **Dissolve** when both are right in different scopes: state the boundary in each note's content.
resolution: Resolved in favour of the package. @renown/sdk's root export list at v6.2.2-dev.74 contains renown-builder and no React provider, and RenownUserProvider appears nowhere in the tree; the SDK's own COMPONENTS.md says the React surface lives in @powerhousedao/reactor-browser. The Academy page describes an earlier, React-shaped SDK and should be read as historical until it is rewritten.
description: “The Academy's Renown SDK page documents a RenownUserProvider and useUser that @renown/sdk does not export” contradicts “The Renown SDK is built through a RenownBuilder whose every dependency is injectable, and its React components live in reactor-browser rath…”.
